author: FreemyerGreg
planOrModel: 截图官方 Cursor Spending：Ultra $200/MO。口述只说 Cursor pricing for Grok。
oralText: Something weird with Cursor pricing for Grok. I checked several hours ago and in just 3 days I had used about 1/3rd of my monthly allotment. That was extremely surprising as it felt like the price had jumped 500% or more. Now, my usage amount has dropped drastically to be…（正文被截断）
conflictsToKeep: 口述数小时前 3 天用掉月额度约 1/3，随后用量大幅下降。当前截图是 Cursor Models 8% used、Other Models 52% used，月重置 Dec 14。1/3 与 8%/52% 不能混成同一个检查点。
why: 官方套餐和百分比清楚，但无 token，且口述 1/3 与当前图冲突。禁止用百分比反推月池。
